description: Copies the behaviour settings (modules, rooms, matchmaking, inbox, theme, AI…) of one of the developer's apps into another's draft, overwriting them there; its users get them after neblla_promote "save" env "pro". Never copies files, name, domains, slug, gallery listing or billing. Returns `copied` and `skipped` (refused fields, to set with neblla_update_app). More: neblla_get_llms tools/copy_app_config

appId.description: The target app, which gets the settings.

fromAppId.description: The source app; its latest settings (pre and draft) are read.

name: neblla_copy_app_config
title: Copy settings between apps
